note: Served-vs-source parity grandfather list (#3689). tests/route-contract-served-parity.test.js boots the test server, fetches the actually-served /openapi.json and /llms.txt, and diffs their route sets against the route-contract census (scripts/route-contract-census.mjs). A census operation that is in neither the served spec nor docs/openapi.yaml nor scripts/route-contract-exemptions.json, and a packet worked example that names no census route, must be listed here with a class and a reason — or the gate fails. Shrink-only, reusing the route-contract-exemptions.json mechanics: an entry whose divergence has closed (now served, now documented, now classified, no longer served, or no longer a packet example) is stale and fails, so entries leave and never arrive. New routes and new packet examples may NOT be grandfathered; document or serve them instead. Seeded at the gate's introduction (2026-10-24) from the census and the served packet at that date.
